question: Can AI label type and sentiment?
setup: 3 Haiku coders, Sonnet on disputes, 12,500 mentions
result: Kappa 0.77-0.79 type, 0.71-0.73 sentiment. No human gold standard

question: Which column groups matter?
setup: Boosting on cumulative groups, against median and constant × followers
result: Constant 0.92 / 0.86 / 0.88; with reactions 0.29 / 0.46 / 0.50

question: Do intervals hold? Does a model transfer?
setup: Split conformal; ridge and boosting on likes + comments, leave one platform out
result: 90% coverage 0.89-0.90, width ×16 / ×104 / ×133 in total; transfer 0.31 / 0.61 / 0.65

question: Do other models or first graph features help?
setup: 6 families + blend on fixed settings; author and text-neighbour features; strata
result: Best 0.28 / 0.45 / 0.48. Graph at most about 0.009. Models per follower tier worse

question: Labels vs views
setup: Residual after reactions, by type
result: Moves views at most about 0.1; only TikTok promo clearly above zero (+0.08)

question: Do extra columns help?
setup: Extra trees; text stats, VADER, TF-IDF, calendar, ratios, brand size
result: Text +0.011-0.016 on YouTube and X; the rest about zero

question: Brand graph, predicting reactions
setup: Brand similarity graph; targets from other columns
result: Brand graph small on X only; reactions predictable (R² up to 0.76), followers less

question: Graph lab
setup: Louvain, PageRank, spectral, author-brand, hashtags, time, duplicates, encodings
result: At most about 0.007; label propagation worse (X -0.021)

question: What does the text graph find?
setup: Homophily, duplicates, type from text
result: Duplicates 6-14% of posts; on X 38% spam against 9%; pair view correlation 0.66-0.82

question: Do reactions transfer to FB/IG? Two-stage reactions then views
setup: Followers + text to reactions across 5 platforms
result: Spearman 0.3-0.47 inside a platform; two-stage no gain

question: Default model vs baselines
setup: scikit-learn boosting with defaults
result: With reactions 0.29 / 0.53 / 0.49

question: Does tuning change the ranking?
setup: 10 families, nested search, 40 settings per fold
result: Best 0.27 (SVR) / 0.45 / 0.47 (CatBoost); ridge 0.55 on YouTube

question: Tuned boosters with text
setup: CatBoost, LightGBM + text stats and TF-IDF
result: At most +0.013

question: Full transfer matrix
setup: 6 models, 3 column sets, 12 pairings, test brands removed
result: Ridge on likes + comments best: 0.31 / 0.61 / 0.65, bias +0.03 / +0.21 / -0.40; order kept

question: Tuning for transfer, label correction
setup: Across-source tuning; reweighting; type as a feature
result: No consistent gain

question: Calibration with few posts
setup: Shift by median error of n target posts
result: On X 25-50 posts bring 0.65 to about 0.55; ideal 0.54. Not checked on FB/IG

question: FB/IG sensitivity to source
setup: Median estimate per source set
result: Spread ×1.7 and ×2.4. Not a measured error

question: Three-way ablation with labels
setup: Alone, added, removed; second learner
result: Removing likes +0.09 / +0.13 / +0.05; labels at most +0.005

question: Systematic errors
setup: Signed error by subgroup
result: Lowest fifth overestimated 0.23 / 0.51 / 0.67, top fifth underestimated 0.20 / 0.42 / 0.56

question: Promo vs views per reaction
setup: Line per type
result: Promo ×1.5-1.9 at equal likes and comments on TikTok and YouTube

question: Dropping spam from training
setup: Extra trees
result: At most 0.002

question: Community detection
setup: Louvain on text kNN, no views or labels

question: False brand matches
setup: Keyword check of one community
result: Cricket Wireless 0 of 20 about the company. One example; frequency unknown

question: YouTube transcripts
setup: Flag for mentions starting with a time stamp
result: 21% of mentions; flag +0.008

question: Brand24 rule
setup: Reconstruct from data
result: Reproduces 98% / 96% / 98% of X, FB, IG; unconfirmed. Real views per reaction 21 / 20 / 27; rule on X 700

question: Rule vs model on X
setup: Same rows
result: Rule 1.08, simple rule with learned constants 0.68, extra trees 0.47

question: One is-promo column
setup: 3 learners, 2 column sets
result: At most +0.006 with followers and reactions; up to +0.012 on likes + comments

question: Is promo behind YouTube errors?
setup: Error by reaction state and promo share
result: Mostly no. Zero likes and comments: 23% of posts, 35% of error. Possible missing data, unconfirmed

question: Removing zero-reaction posts
setup: From test, and from training
result: Test 0.27 / 0.38 / 0.45 because it is easier; training gain at most 0.002

question: Second graph round
setup: Fixed aggregation, cross-platform neighbours, community shrinkage
result: Only cross-platform on YouTube +0.009; a hint given many tests. Slopes differ by community on TikTok and YouTube

question: Graph bridge across platforms
setup: Neighbours from other platforms, leave one out
result: Level shift unchanged; ridge on zero-reaction posts only +0.018-0.022

question: Two-stage models
setup: Tier classifier, routing, residuals, hurdle, promo, community
result: No clear gain; residual stacking worse

question: MAE loss
setup: Default CatBoost, RMSE to MAE

question: Error by reaction tier
setup: CatBoost MAE; ridge out of platform
result: YouTube ×4.6 to ×1.8; X ×3.1 to ×2.5; TikTok flat after the first reaction

question: Interval per reaction tier
setup: Mondrian conformal
result: One width covers 67-87% at zero reactions; per tier about 90%, except TikTok at zero

question: False match seen in the text graph
setup: TikTok TF-IDF 10-NN graph, Louvain; Cricket Wireless against six mobile-network brands
result: All 20 Cricket Wireless mentions in one group with cricket posts (Aon); 4 edges to the 28 mobile-network posts

question: Brand industry labels
setup: Haiku agent, general knowledge, 348 brands
result: 20 industries; 83 names flagged as having another meaning; 2 low confidence

question: Brand away from its industry in the text graph
setup: Share of other-brand neighbours from the same industry vs chance, 5 platforms
result: Lowest include Frontier (X, AI), Gap (YouTube, AI), Guardian Life (Minecraft), Wrangler (Jeep); some are other languages; Cricket Wireless not low (lift 1.4 on TikTok); AUC vs name flag 0.62 (0.55-0.69)

question: What is in the second Brand24 file?
setup: `reach_samples_students_with_history.csv`: same 12,500 mentions, 23 new columns
result: History (up to 3 earlier checks) only on TikTok 341 and X 349 posts, almost all from 2026-08; latest check (`current_*`) for 1,230 posts incl. 512 YouTube. Old 19 columns unchanged; views never fall between checks; history and current times are Polish local time (+2 h), converted to UTC

question: How fast do views grow?
setup: Power law views ~ age^b between first and last check, brand bootstrap
result: b 0.35 (0.29-0.39) / 0.58 (0.50-0.66) / 1.17 (0.76-1.93); median growth ×1.3 / ×1.2 / ×2.4 from 30 h / 102 h / 7.5 h to 222 h / 706 h / 14 h. X checks in this subset cover only the first day

question: Forecast later views from the first check
setup: CatBoost (MAE loss) on growth with first-check views, reactions, ages; against persistence and power law

question: Forecast without views at the first check
setup: Same CatBoost, first-check reactions + followers + ages only
result: 0.368 / 0.444 / 0.544; the early view count is worth 0.20-0.28 of MAE

question: Interval of the forecast
setup: Leave-brand-out residual quantile, 90%

question: Estimate at posting time (no reactions)
setup: CatBoost on followers, text stats, VADER, TF-IDF SVD, AI labels, calendar, horizon, brand size; + author history from training fold
result: 0.575 / 0.684 / 0.550 against constant × followers 0.912 / 0.860 / 0.880 and followers-only CatBoost 0.591 / 0.775 / 0.584; author history +0.001 / -0.002 / +0.004 (CI includes zero); 90% interval ×20 / ×27 / ×14; with reactions 0.27 / 0.45 / 0.45

question: Does the age of the view check help the final model?
setup: Final CatBoost (MAE loss, followers + reactions + flags) + log10 hours from posting to the check; error by age of the check

question: Are the newer checks more predictable?
setup: Views, reactions and age replaced by the latest check (`current_*`) for 348 / 503 / 342 posts; same model, folds and posts
result: On the refreshed posts -0.010 (-0.017 to -0.002) / +0.006 (-0.011-0.020) / -0.046 (-0.066 to -0.027): not better, worse on X, where views grew in 10% of these posts while reactions changed in 1%

question: Rolling window: does the final model hold up when trained only on earlier months?
setup: Final model trained on all months before M, tested on M = 2026-05 … 08 (1,949 / 2,000 / 1,685 posts); against brand CV on the same posts; also without the test month's brands, and previous month only
result: Expanding window vs brand CV -0.001 (-0.004-0.002) / -0.011 (-0.018 to -0.004) / -0.026 (-0.036 to -0.017); most of the gap is May (X 0.552 vs 0.480), from June on within 0.02. Unseen brands cost ≤ 0.005 more; previous month only is worse (-0.013 / -0.023 / -0.032). No drift in error; YouTube views per like fell in Jul-Aug without raising the error

question: Do tabular foundation models (TabPFN v2, TabICL) beat or add to the final model?
setup: TabPFN v2 regressor (median output) and TabICL v2, 8 estimators, seeds 0/1/2, same ENG features and brand folds as the final CatBoost (2,491 / 2,441 / 1,803 posts); plain means; CPU, 2-4 min per model and platform
result: TabPFN vs CatBoost +0.005 (0.003-0.008) / +0.010 (0.004-0.017) / +0.002 (-0.003-0.007); mean of all three +0.004 (0.002-0.006) / +0.010 (0.006-0.014) / +0.003 (-0.000-0.006). YouTube gain is not only zero-reaction posts (+0.009 with reactions); TikTok gain sits in posts with > 1,000 reactions (+0.026). Small

question: Classification: viral top 10%, and posts without a view count
setup: Top 10% of views per platform on held-out brands: followers, Brand24 reach (X only; equals views on TikTok/YouTube), final regression, CatBoost classifier. Missing/zero views (9 / 59 / 697 posts) vs present: classifier on date, age at check, reactions
result: Regression ranks viral posts as well as a classifier: AUC 0.983 / 0.935 / 0.894, precision in top 10% 83% / 71% / 63% vs followers 36% / 44% / 43%. On X, 2025 posts almost never have views (12 of 170); missing/zero is predictable (AUC 0.95 YouTube, 0.91 X): a collection artefact. Zero-view posts get 9-15 predicted views on YouTube and X

question: Context from other posts of the same author, hashtag and brand (no view counts used)
setup: Leave-self-out features from all 12,500 mentions: author, hashtags, brand on platform and other platforms, text copies; added to the final model, and to a followers-only model
result: Next to reactions nothing ≥ 0.01; brand context worse on YouTube (-0.014, CI -0.019 to -0.008); author +0.003 (CI incl. 0). Without reactions all context +0.007 / +0.054 / +0.009

question: Text: local sentence embeddings (multilingual-e5-small) and TF-IDF
setup: PCA 16 of embeddings and TF-IDF SVD 16, unsupervised; added to the final model and to followers only
result: With reactions: embeddings +0.003 / -0.009 / +0.011 (X CI 0.002-0.020); TF-IDF about 0. Without reactions: embeddings +0.009 / +0.051 / +0.018, TF-IDF +0.005 / +0.051 / +0.010

question: Offset target: learn views per like
setup: CatBoost on log10(views) - log10(likes+1), offset added back; same features and folds
result: +0.001 / +0.007 (0.003-0.010) / +0.000; bias of extreme fifths narrows only 0.01-0.03. Compression is regression to the mean, not tree extrapolation

question: Posting-time estimate with sentence embeddings and context from other posts
setup: E43 posting-time columns + e5 embeddings (PCA 16), TF-IDF replaced by embeddings, + E49 context without own likes, + both; same folds
result: Context +0.004 / +0.020 (0.011-0.027) / +0.008; embeddings ≤ +0.009; both +0.008 / +0.017 / +0.010. Best posting-time MAE 0.566 / 0.664 / 0.540. Context uses later posts too: upper bound

question: Leakage audit: folds that also separate authors and copied texts
setup: Final model on brand folds, brand ∪ author ∪ identical-text components, and random folds
result: Strict folds +0.002 / -0.001 / -0.011 (X CI -0.020 to -0.003); random folds +0.003 / +0.009 / -0.002. Headline holds; X slightly optimistic (0.47 → 0.48); seen brands help little

question: Noise ceiling: posts with almost the same inputs
setup: Pairs of different-brand posts with all four log inputs within 0.05; best MAE ≥ ½ mean \
result: Δ\
where: Lower bound 0.223 / 0.388 / 0.333 vs final model 0.325 / 0.578 / 0.471 on the same posts; near-identical posts differ ×2.8 / ×6.0 / ×4.6 in views

question: Quantile models and tail weighting
setup: CatBoost MultiQuantile 10/50/90%; final model with weight 2 on the outer fifths
result: 10-90% covers 73-74% (top fifth 44-54%); median ×5.4 / ×14.1 / ×28.9; q50 +0.007 on YouTube; tail weighting ≤ 0.002, extremes unchanged

question: Abstention: error on the posts kept
setup: Final model errors ranked by quantile width, tier width, random, oracle
result: Keeping the 50% narrowest: -10% / -27% / -6% MAE (0.246 / 0.334 / 0.439); quantile width slightly better than tier width

question: Forecast horizon curve; training on every pair of checks
setup: E40 CatBoost on growth, first-last pairs vs all 3,218 pairs; error by gap and by age of the first check
result: All pairs -0.020 / 0.000 / +0.008 (worse on TikTok). TikTok error grows with the gap (0.10 < 12 h → 0.18 at 7-30 d); a first check < 12 h is 2-4× harder (0.23 / 0.43 / 0.28)

question: Early-reaction forecast without views (FB/IG setting)
setup: TikTok / X: later likes from early likes; chain forecast reactions → now-cast model; vs E41
result: Likes +0.068 over persistence on TikTok, none on X. Chain beats E41: +0.034 (0.012-0.058) TikTok, +0.033 (-0.010-0.077) X; upper bound with true later reactions +0.076 / +0.110

question: One pooled model for three platforms, monotone constraints
setup: Joint brand folds; per platform vs pooled (platform category), ± monotone on followers and reactions; LOPO CatBoost vs ridge

question: Why YouTube views per like fell in Jul-Aug
setup: Median age at check, views per like and monthly bias, ± age column
result: Age at check fell from 78-100 days (Apr-May) to 0.6-8 days (Aug) on all platforms; YouTube views per like fell 1.57 → 1.13, TikTok/X flat; age column does not remove the monthly bias

question: Copy-paste campaigns
setup: Same normalised text elsewhere in the data; views per like, reach share, model error
result: Copies 1-6% of posts; more views per like (1.62 vs 1.38 TikTok); model 2× worse on them and underestimates YouTube copies by 0.26; 6 YouTube and 7 X brands get > 50% of reach from copies

question: Separate model for posts without likes and comments
setup: YouTube 665 / X 991 such posts; final model vs all-post model + text and context vs zero-only model
result: All-post + text and context +0.030 (0.016-0.045) on X, -0.005 on YouTube; zero-only model no gain
